answer: Measure the enclave, not the address. Each task carries a quote from a hardware TEE, and attestations from one subnet are taxed, so a rack of clones vouching for itself earns a fraction of a share. Take one example: 200 identities on one host produce one quote family and 200 taxed votes, worth less than 20 honest tasks on a ridge of separate hosts. The beacon is the task record, not the timber of account names.
